# Browser 3D viewer

`model-viewer.min.js` is the unmodified self-contained distribution from `@google/model-viewer` 4.4.0 (Google), downloaded through npm. The package license file is included alongside it; the distribution identifies BSD-3-Clause and retains embedded third-party license notices. Source: https://github.com/google/model-viewer/tree/v4.4.0. Documentation: https://modelviewer.dev/.

The models are Jenga project exports. No third-party model hosting or analytics service is used by this website.
